title: How to Apply for a US Visa From India: DS-160 Form and Interview Steps
seoTitle: How to Apply for US Visa From India: DS-160 to Interview
seoDescription: Apply for a US visa from India: fill the DS-160, pay the $185 fee, book VAC and interview slots, carry the right documents. 2025-26 rules explained.
